t: The Hager Sollysta WMSSU83N 13A switched fused spur with LED features a raised slim profile and a secure screwed faceplate, ensuring a tidy installation. Angled in-line terminals with backed-out captive screws and clearly marked terminals simplify wiring, accommodating up to 6mm² cables. Installation is straightforward, requiring a minimum 25mm back box.
b: Angled In-Line Terminals with Backed-Out Captive Screws
